criterion.criterion_summary: Removing a metric must not improve a candidate on the same task. Different required metric sets must be incomparable or handled by an explicit prior comparison rule. Repeat means must retain and expose their actual per-metric denominators rather than imply one common sample.

coverage_owner.criterion_specific_acceptance_not_execut: closure expansion to optional metrics/other methods is an unsupported proxy.

property_and_result.bounded_property: The SMM path requires one declared required-moment set for comparison/ranking. A candidate missing any required moment in any repeat has infinite loss and cannot win. Counts are computed for every returned key over all supplied repeats, optional moments are diagnostic only, and the selected SMMResult plus registered pure_step output retain the fitted per-key counts, repeat denominator and comparison basis.
property_and_result.observed_result: The local selected tests cover six test_estimation.py cases, one actual coupled pure_step serializer test, and two named SIM03 negative controls; all nine B25-relevant cases pass in the R161 mixed run. This does not establish a real accepted calibration decision.
property_and_result.p37: Required names are recomputed from the explicit required_moment_names input or the observed summary when omitted; per-key counts are recomputed over each actual runner summary and the denominator is len(summaries). No caller-declared count is accepted as the result.
property_and_result.p38: The property is complete required-set comparability and honest repeat denominators; the mechanism checks required keys across each repeat and makes any missing required key incomparable, while counting optional keys for diagnostics only. The divergent case is an optional signal observed in one versus all three repeats: its count changes, but it cannot change the required-set ranking. The actual assertions and required-only removal mutant distinguish this from status/basis markers.
